newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile issues new ferro-columbium offer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile issues new ferro-columbium offer.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said it will issue a new solicitation for bids for 94,000 pounds of ferro-columbium now available for the rest of the current fiscal year which ends September 30.
Ferro-columbium is also known as ferro-niobium.
The ferro-columbium represents some 60,000 pounds of contained columbium metal.
A Stockpile official said the first opening of bids would be on March 11, when the entire amount will be available for sale.
